question: What changed in the latest Autodesk Fusion update?
answer:
Based on Autodesk Fusion's October 2026 release (v.2706.1.14 on October 21, 2026, followed by minor update v.2706.1.17 on October 28, 2026) [2].

Main changes in the October 2026 update:
- **Auto Timeline:** It uses AI-assisted feature reconstruction to turn imported, non-native geometry into an editable parametric design. It currently reconstructs extrudes, revolves, chamfers, fillets, holes and basic sweeps [3].
- **System Modeler:** A node-based, no-code environment for automating design and manufacturing tasks [3]. It is available for users with access to the Fusion Manufacturing Extension [6].
- **Performance:** Up to 35% faster open, save and edit on large, nested assemblies, and up to 80% faster opening of legacy assemblies after a one-time override cleanup [2].
- **Manufacturing (turning):** The fixture is shown in its true position after a bar pull, groove roughing clears cusps as they form, and groove roughing and finishing now have a tool limit [3].
- **Electronics:** Drill views, drill tables and copper views were added in the electronic section of the drawings toolbar [3]. Polygon Pour is now called Copper Pour in Fusion Electronics, with a single toggle for fill visibility [2].
- **Data management:** Integrated task management with Kanban or list boards, which Autodesk Assistant can create and update [2][3]. Copy Designs Across Fusion Hubs was also added. Both are staged rollouts over about two weeks [2].
- **Other:** Autodesk Assistant has better context awareness, API coverage is broader [2], and there is improved design reservation and a new selection bar for machining [3].

The minor update v.2706.1.17 is stability work, including fixes for assemblies with inconsistent component data and for the Render workspace appearing blank during section analysis [2].

Autodesk also announced that at the end of March 2027, Fusion will require an Apple silicon Mac to remain up to date [2].

studyNotes.focus: The user wants to know what changed in the most recent Autodesk Fusion update, which per the sources is the October 2026 release.

keyPoints.text: The October 2026 Fusion update adds AI-assisted Auto Timeline that turns imported non-native geometry into an editable parametric design.
System Modeler, a no-code node-based visual workflow automation tool, arrives with the October 2026 release for users with the Fusion Manufacturing Extension.
The October update delivers faster performance on large nested assemblies, with up to 35% faster open, save and edit.
Integrated Task Management lets teams organize work on Kanban or list boards linked to Fusion designs, rolling out gradually over about two weeks.
Electronics updates include eCAD drill views, drill tables and copper views, and Polygon Pour was renamed Copper Pour.

mayBeStale.text: The latest minor build cited is v.2706.1.17 (October 28, 2026), and the 'latest version' number on older support pages may no longer match.
Support article on finding the latest version and update steps is dated earlier than the October release and may not reflect current build numbers or menu paths.
Staged rollout features such as Task Management and Copy Designs Across Hubs may not yet be available to every user.
Intel Mac support ends at the end of March 2027, so Intel-based Macs will stop receiving Fusion updates.
